beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Illness Machine asks how social arrangements enter the causes and persistence of mental distress.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It investigates causal pathways rather than claiming society explains every disorder.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book compares different kinds of evidence and confronts findings inconvenient to its thesis.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its practical tension is between treating suffering and changing conditions that keep producing exposure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers encounter an inquiry into institutional responsibility that preserves the importance of clinical care.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The opening follows a change in family income that became an unexpected research opportunity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book uses it to ask which social changes can help distinguish causation from association.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different research designs provide different leverage, and none makes every setting interchangeable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Biological vulnerability remains part of the inquiry rather than an inconvenient fact to exclude.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This evidential discipline matters because an attractive social explanation can still be too broad.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A clinic can help a distressed person while harmful conditions continue elsewhere.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines institutions that distribute exposure, shape interpretation, or make recovery harder.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its case against itself confronts evidence that resists a simple social account.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The constructive chapters consider prevention alongside treatment, without promising a world free of mental illness.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers encounter a question about causal responsibility rather than a substitute for individual clinical judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the casino research story and the opening discussion of causal evidence.
